casino.interrupted_body: In the event of disconnection, a previously started round that has been interrupted may be resumed immediately by starting the game again. The results of a completed round (where display of the visual result was interrupted) will only be re-displayed within the game for winning rounds, but all game rounds may be reviewed in History. Any amount wagered on an unfinished game will remain paused until you either complete the game or the game is void as a result of account inactivity or system maintenance. When an unfinished game is void, your bet will be refunded to your account. Any awards earned on an unfinished round will not be credited unless you resume and complete the game. Winnings on unfinished game rounds where the player cannot further influence the outcome of the game will be automatically credited to the player's account after [[:period]]. Game rounds that require additional player input to determine the outcome of the game will remain unfinished for [[:period]], after which a default choice will automatically be made in order to complete the round and credit any winnings to the player's account. Game rounds will never be affected by unforeseen external errors due to hardware, bandwidth, network errors or similar. Game rounds will be either stored and completed by the player at a later time or they will be closed and the wager will be refunded to the player. If an incomplete game round has not been resumed within [[:rollbackAfter]], the round will be rolled back and the wager will be refunded.

casino.jackpot_body:
All Max Wins will be manually reviewed to ensure compliance with Hacksaw Gaming's terms and conditions as well as the terms and conditions of the operator. Any evidence of abuse or collusion will result in a loss of any Max Wins. All decisions are final.
After any Max Win Hacksaw Gaming reserves the right to request proof of age and perform checks in order to verify the identity and information provided by the account holder. These rules apply for the account holder:
- must not be under 18 years of age;
- must provide proof of address;
- must be a physical person (a legal entity will not be accepted);
- must not to be acting on behalf of another party;
- must not to be restricted by limited legal capacity.

The Max Win can not be won when playing in demo mode. Max Win winners will be contacted within 48 hours to verify the win.
casino.jackpot_won: Congratulations! You will be contacted within 48 hours to verify the win. All Max Win winnings will be manually reviewed to ensure compliance with current terms and conditions.

casino.win_body: Winnings and winning combinations are paid according to the paytable. Multiple wins in one round are added together and the total round win will be displayed in the WIN field (to the right of BALANCE). Separate wins in a winning combination will be displayed during the win presentation. Symbol payouts are displayed in the paytable and reflect the current bet configuration. Only the highest win per winning way is paid. Some win amounts may be displayed in an abbreviated format using letters to represent large numbers. When a win amount is displayed in this format, the displayed value may be rounded down. The actual amount awarded will never be less than the displayed value.

casino.no_brainer_desc: 10 free spins with EyeBall symbols shooting in two different directions!
casino.about_the_game_desc_2: The mad genius is at it again! Accompanied by Mr. Brain, they’ve successfully conducted a new experiment. A beast so ferocious it can trample an entire city in minutes! But don’t fear, the Doctor is here!
casino.about_the_game_desc_3: Experiment with the mad duo in [[Dr Zappo]], a 5-reel, 4-row game with payline wins for an electric max win of [[:maximumWinMultiplier]] times your bet, achievable in all game modes!
casino.wild_eyeball_symbols_desc_1: When an EyeBall symbol lands, it can only land on the 4th row of the grid. Once the grid has settled, all EyeBall symbols shoot in 1 of 3 directions: straight up, diagonally left, or diagonally right. EyeBall symbols activate in order from left to right.
casino.wild_eyeball_symbols_desc_2: When an EyeBall shoots, every paying symbol along its path transforms into a [[Wild]] symbol. These transformed symbols can remain [[Wild]] or reveal an Additive Multiplier value. [[Wild]] symbols substitute for all symbols in the paytable. Multiplier values revealed on [[Wild]] symbols can be: [[2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 200x]].
casino.wild_eyeball_symbols_desc_3: If an EyeBall symbol hits an existing [[Wild]] symbol, that [[Wild]] symbol gains a Multiplier value. If an EyeBall symbol hits a [[Wild]] symbol with a Multiplier, the Multiplier value of that [[Wild]] will increase by adding a new Multiplier value to the existing [[Wild]] Multiplier. Multiplier values added to [[Wild]] symbols can be: [[1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 200x]].
casino.wild_eyeball_symbols_desc_4: Activated EyeBall symbols transform into [[Wild]] symbols. If more than 1 [[Wild]] Multiplier symbol is part of the same winning combination, the values are first added together before being applied to the win.
casino.energy_fields_desc_1: There are 3 Energy Fields located on the left, top, and right edges of the grid. If an EyeBall symbol activates and hits an Energy Field, the EyeBall will bounce off the Energy Field and continue in another direction at the same angle. The EyeBall symbol will continue to transform paying symbols in its path into [[Wild]] symbols.
casino.energy_fields_desc_2: When an EyeBall symbol hits a Energy Field straight on, the EyeBall will bounce back the same way it came from, adding Multiplier values to the transformed [[Wild]] symbols. If an EyeBall hits an EyeBall symbol, it adds a Multiplier value.
casino.bonus_game_eyeconic_desc_1: Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 3 [[FS]] [[scatter]] symbols at the same time during the base game.
casino.bonus_game_eyeconic_desc_2: This bonus keeps the base game's mechanics, with an increased chance of landing EyeBall symbols!
casino.bonus_retrigger_desc_1: Landing additional [[FS]] symbols at the same time in the bonus awards extra free spins:
casino.bonus_game_no_brainer_desc_1: Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 4 [[FS]] [[scatter]] symbols at the same time during the base game.
casino.bonus_game_no_brainer_desc_2: This bonus keeps the mechanics of the [[EYECONIC]] bonus. In addition each EyeBall symbol that activates will shoot in two different directions on one spin!
casino.its_electrifying_bonus_info_desc_1: Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 5 [[FS]] [[scatter]] symbols at the same time during the base game.
casino.its_electrifying_bonus_info_desc_2: This bonus keeps the mechanics of the [[NO-BRAINER]] bonus. In addition, at least one EyeBall symbol will land on every free spin! [[FS]] symbols cannot land in this bonus.
casino.special_symbols_body: [[FS]] symbols cannot land at the same time as EyeBall symbols.
casino.maxwingermany_body: Maximum win: [[:maximumWinMultiplier]] times the total stake. Probability of getting the maximum win: 1:[[:oddsofmaxwin]]. The maximum win occurs when [[5]] EyeBall symbols land at the bottom of each reel, activating and transforming paying symbols into Wild symbols with random Multipliers being added to the transformed symbols, which will form winning combinations until the max win of [[10 000x]] is reached. The maximum win is the sum of all winning combinations when the reels are stationary, taking into account further winning opportunities such as bonus rounds and free spins. The maximum win can be achieved in the base game but is only possible with a lower probability if bonus rounds are excluded.
